about: A listenable edge's scopedBy judged against what its module describes, by engine-contracts unreadableListening and crates/lf schema.rs unreadable_listening, word for word. `entries` is a connection walking to its tables through its bases; `positioned` is one positioned at a base, whose tables are a root collection.

cases.name: an earlier hop on every path to the edge
the hop the edge hangs off
a path from a root collection that skips it
cases.refusal: 'Changes' declares 'scopedBy: Bases', but the path Tables → Changes comes through no 'Bases': it must come before 'Changes' on every path to it

cases.name: a hop on no path
cases.refusal: 'Changes' declares 'scopedBy: Nope', but the path Bases → Tables → Changes comes through no 'Nope': it must come before 'Changes' on every path to it

cases.name: an edge not subscribed per scope
cases.refusal: 'Changes' declares 'scopedBy' but not 'delivery: scope': only an edge subscribed per scope is scoped by an earlier hop

cases.name: a root collection
cases.refusal: 'Tables' declares 'scopedBy', and 'Tables' is a root collection: nothing comes before it to scope a subscription by
